y_pred_1995 = slope * x_1995 + intercept
avg_1995 = y_pred_1995 / 12

print(f"Projected average for FY1995 (sum / 12): {avg_1995:,.2f}")
print(f"Rounded to nearest whole number: {round(avg_1995)}")

# Write answer
print(f"\nFinal answer: {round(avg_1995)}")
